name: Geography
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of the entire earth and heavens, establishing the geography of the world by His divine design. From the creation of the heavens and the earth in Genesis 1:1 to the description of the earth's shape and the heavens stretched out like a tent in Isaiah 40:22, the Bible affirms God's authority over all physical creation. The mountains and valleys move according to His foundation as described in Psalms 104:8, and Isaiah 45:12 emphasizes that God not only made the earth but also created mankind upon it, commanding all the hosts of heaven. This teaches us that the geography of the world is purposeful, reflecting the power and wisdom of the Creator.
